name: misaki-ordering
description: Ordering app for Misaki @ Superior: web, Mac, Windows and iPhone.

scripts.desktop: vite build && node electron/stage.mjs && electron electron
scripts.desktop:mac: vite build && node electron/stage.mjs && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.desktop:win: vite build && node electron/stage.mjs && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.ios: vite build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
